items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, considered day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; status up in the air for Week 2 vs Raiders, will monitor how he feels this week.
items.why: Left game with chest/rib after big hit, imaging, Harbaugh DTD
items.implication: Risk of missing Week 2; monitor practice
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for Quentin Johnston, Tre Harris if out

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after last week's meniscus trim; optimistic short-term, possible Week 2 return.
items.why: Meniscus cleanup recovery progressing well per coach
items.implication: Could play Week 2 vs LAC; Mayer filled in with 6 catches
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated role if Bowers limited/out

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring not serious, considered day-to-day; left early after big game. Ja'Kobi Lane fractured wrist, multi-game absence.
items.why: Aggravated hamstring, MRI but not major; Lane wrist fracture
items.implication: Flowers likely plays through if needed; Lane out multi weeks
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman viable add/more targets if Flowers limited

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Flowers hamstring, McConkey chest, BTJ shoulder, Murray concussion, Lane wrist, others. Love/Odunze expected, Kamara not, Nabers pending (later active).
items.why: Post-game injury report aggregation for fantasy impact
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries per OUT cases (e.g. Bateman, Harris)

items.text: Kenneth Walker ran for 173 yards in Chiefs debut — most for any KC player since Mahomes became starter. Confirmed as main guy.
items.why: Explosive debut workload and production with Mahomes
items.implication: Immediate high-end RB1 in KC offense

items.text: Jalen Coker big game believed as sign of things to come, not one-off; Coke Heads unite. Called out previously on FF Happy Hour.
items.why: Strong Week 1 production + prior belief in role

items.text: Ashton Jeanty ascends high-end RB1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 2 TDs, 156 scrimmage yds. Utilization elite; every-down player.
items.why: Dominant share and efficiency in new scheme/OL

items.text: Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2/WR3/TE2 usage.
items.why: Post-Week 1 opportunity share data confirms elite concentration
items.implication: Lock in core four; fade any Lions depth for fantasy
items.opportunity: Near-monopoly on touches/targets/routes for the four

items.text: Bucky Irving usage solid despite points overstated: only 8 carries (1 GL TD), 21 routes/7 targets (all caught). Only RB carry inside 10; out-routed Gainwell 21-13. Looked healthy; strong vs CLE next.
items.why: GL work, route edge over Gainwell, health confirmation
items.implication: Mid RB2 with goal-line/receiving role locked; Gainwell clear backup

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but 92% route participation; two almost-plays. Buying low everywhere possible.
items.why: Elite route share despite low production; process over results
items.opportunity: High route share signals future target volume

items.text: Surprised Travis Etienne didn't dominate more with Kamara out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opps 18/9/4. Committee even without Kamara.
items.why: Split work despite Kamara inactive; low route share
items.implication: Low-end RB2 even solo; Kamara return further dilutes
items.opportunity: Miller/Donaldson handcuff value; Kamara expected Week 2 return

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected Week 1 but recovery faster; expected to return Week 2. Affects Etienne projections heavily.
items.why: MCL recovery ahead of schedule; plan for Week 2 debut
items.implication: Etienne role shrinks on return; committee likely

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Deshaun Watson dropbacks. Even with Dylan Sampson (knee) out early, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Minimal passing-game involvement despite backup out

items.text: Malik Nabers so unsure he would play SNF that family didn't attend; decided ~2 hours before kickoff. Was active.
items.why: Late decision on knee; played through uncertainty
items.implication: Cleared and produced; monitor residual but positive
